claims.statement: Ned Donelly sued Tom Allen before Justice Walther for $125, which he claimed was due for sparring exhibitions at the Comique.

claims.statement: The hearing of Ned Donelly's suit against Tom Allen was postponed until two o'clock the next afternoon.

claims.statement: Tom Allen gave sparring exhibitions at the Comique some weeks before May 1876.
claims.excerpt: certain sparring exhibitions given at the Comique some weeks ago

claims.statement: A battle between Joe Goss and Tom Allen was stated to be set for an early day.
claims.excerpt: It is now definitely stated that a battle will take place at an early day between Joe Goss and Tom Allen.

claims.statement: Both parties put up forfeit money at Cincinnati, printed as 'Five hun-ched collars' (probably $500 each), to be raised to $1,000 once the time and place were set.
